mapper.insert: INSERT INTO farm_zone (organization_id, farm_id, name, zone_type, area_value, area_unit, display_order, active_yn, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{organizationId}, #{farmId}, #{name}, #{zoneType}, #{areaValue}, #{areaUnit}, #{displayOrder}, #{activeYn}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, organization_id, farm_id, name, zone_type, area_value, area_unit, display_order, active_yn, version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted_at FROM farm_zone WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, organization_id, farm_id, name, zone_type, area_value, area_unit, display_order, active_yn, version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted_at FROM farm_zone WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM farm_zone_assignment WHERE farm_id = #{farmId} AND zone_id = #{zoneId} AND effective_to IS NULL AND active_yn = 'Y' FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, organization_id, farm_id, name, zone_type, area_value, area_unit, display_order, active_yn, version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted_at FROM farm_zone WHERE farm_id = #{farmId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND active_yn = 'Y'
ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE farm_zone SET name = #{name}, zone_type = #{zoneType}, area_value = #{areaValue}, area_unit = #{areaUnit}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND farm_id = #{farmId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO farm_zone_assignment (organization_id, zone_id, farm_id, effective_from, effective_to, change_event_id, active_yn, version, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{organizationId}, #{zoneId}, #{farmId}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{changeEventId}, #{activeYn}, COALESCE(#{version},0), #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, organization_id, zone_id, farm_id, effective_from, effective_to, change_event_id, active_yn, version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM farm_zone_assignment WHERE farm_id = #{farmId} ORDER BY zone_id ASC, effective_from ASC
